newsitem.title: USA: Data Translation unit files for spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Data Translation unit files for spinoff.

text.p: Data Translation Inc said on Monday its Data Translation II Inc subsidiary, soon to be spun off, had filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commision to register its common stock.

Data Translation said in July it would spin off its data acquisition and imaging businesses from its Media 100 digital media group. Stock in the new company would be distributed to shareholders as a dividend, it said.
The spinoff was due to close by the end of November.
Data Translation also said in a statement it intended to give Data Translation II additional capital of $10 million in cash and cash equivalents, for use in the spinoff's businesses.
Data Translation II would also receive net proceeds from the previously announced sale of the company's networking distribution business, if a deal were done before the spinoff.
The company said in July it intended to divest its networking business by the end of July 1997.
Data Translation II would also assume liabilities related to transferred businesses, the company said.
